questions.stem: A sum at 10% CI triples in 'n' years and becomes 9 times in 'm' years. Which relation holds?
questions.explanation: If the sum triples in n years, it becomes 3² = 9 times in 2n years. CI growth is exponential: (growth factor)^n = 3 and (growth factor)^m = 9 = 3² → m = 2n.
